title: Managed Backup: outage credit cap
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines outage credit cap.

## Tier basis

**Cumulative outage credit cap fraction.** Maximum cumulative outage credit fraction of the source charge net service subtotal; decimal.

| Contract tier | Cumulative outage credit cap fraction |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 0.3 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, cumulative outage credit cap fraction is 0.3.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, cumulative outage credit cap fraction stays the same.
